notes.title: Ahead of Rebirth's PC port, get this underrated Final Fantasy game for 50% off
notes.content:
While it's a very distinct entry in the long-running series, Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origin is nothing short of amazing. The unique twist on the Final Fantasy formula provides an alternative prequel to the franchise, delivering an action-heavy gameplay loop that keeps you coming back again and again. Ahead of Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth's PC port, it's worth picking up for something a little different, and we've got a deal that nets you 50% off.

notes.content:

Will restoring the crystals' light usher in peace or a new form of darkness? ...Or perhaps something else entirely?
